stories.title: Hughes Pharmacy moves to bigger shop in Mold’s Daniel Owen Shopping Centre
stories.summary: Hughes Pharmacy at Daniel Owen Shopping Centre in Mold is moving into a bigger shop in the centre on Monday 23 November. stories.title: Connah’s Quay wrestler Drew Parker to appear at Deeside Leisure Centre
stories.summary: The former Big Japan Pro Wrestling star has joined the National Wrestling League, which holds its first Welsh show in Queensferry on Friday 27 November.

stories.title: Andy Burnham says no to Wales taking control of policing, rail infrastructure and The Crown Estate
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said no to Wales taking control of its own policing, railway infrastructure and The Crown Estate. stories.title: 109 affordable homes in Flint get final sign-off after legal agreement
stories.summary: Formal planning permission has been issued for 109 affordable homes at Oakenholt in Flint, after a legal agreement with the developer was completed. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee backed Castle Green Homes’ plans for Quarry Farm, off Leadbrook Drive, in July.
